news.title: SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters
news.summary_raw:

news.summary: Microsoft Research has developed SkillOpt, an AI framework that enables trainable agent skills by turning skill editing into a training process. This approach makes agent behavior more reliable without modifying model weights, potentially improving overall performance.
news.enterprise_use: Currently, this is a low signal with no direct action, so check the Microsoft Research updates for potential tooling or platform implications in the future (note in 90 days).

news.title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
news.summary_raw:
AI agents can't remember past conversations. They must constantly reload or retrieve context, which grows less efficient as tasks get longer and more complex. Memora solves this with a scalable memory system separating what’s stored from how it's retrieved.
The post Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Memora, a scalable memory system that separates stored and retrieved context, solving AI agents' past conversation recall issues. This can improve task efficiency and complexity handling in various applications.
news.enterprise_use: While there is no direct action to take now, it's worth following Microsoft's AI advancements, including this memory representation innovation, as it may influence future product developments and AI capabilities in Google Workspace, particularly in the area of chatbots and virtual assistance.

news.title: Enterprises lost Claude Fable 5 for a few weeks. New data shows two-thirds had already built their hedge

It returned this week wrapped in tighter safeguards, after China's Z.ai released its open-weights GLM-5.2 into the vacuum. New V
news.summary: Two-thirds of enterprises have already diversified their AI model strategy after a US export-control order briefly pulled Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 offline, but the model has now returned with tighter safeguards due to the release of China's Z.ai GLM-5.2. This highlights the importance of hedging against model availability and geopolitical risks.
news.enterprise_use: Review your organization's AI model strategy and consider building a diversified approach to reduce reliance on a single model. This can include exploring alternative models and vendors, as seen in the release of China's Z.ai GLM-5.2.
